title: 電気通信法令
subtitle: Telecommunications Law
keywords: Telecommunications Business Act 2.National Exam for Chief Telecommunications Engineer 3.Telecommunications Technology, Information and Communications 4.Electronic Signatures, Information Security 5.Regional Collaboration
educationalGoal: This course introduces the laws and regulations required for obtaining qualifications to students taking this course. Students acquire the knowledge of telecommunications law for the operation of the telecommunications business and for the national exam of the Chief Telecommunications Engineer.
advice: The outline of this course is shown in below. 1. Introduction: Trends of telecommunication policy, Amendment of Telecommunications Business Act, Summary of telecommunications system etc. 2. Telecommunications business Act,Enforcement order and regulations: Purpose, Definition, Registration, Notifications, Facilities for telecommunications business, Terminal Facilities, Chief Telecommunications Engineer, Rules of Installation, Technician, Land-use. 3. Wire telecommunications Act, Enforcement order and regulations: Purpose, Definition, Technical Standards. 4. Radio Act and Enforcement regulations: Purpose, Definition, Radio Station license, Radio facilities, Radio operators, Operation, Supervision. 5. Treaty of International Telecommunications, the related law and regulations: The Treaty of International Telecommunication Union, Act on Prohibition of Unauthorized Computer Access, Summary of Electronic Signatures and Certification, Business and the related laws. 6. Telecommunications trends: Summary To pass, students must earn at least 60 points out of 100.
requiredKnowledge: Students should collect the recent information about telecommunications technology, internet services and mobile phones. Through these interesting and activity, they are able to obtain the knowledge regarding to the telecommunications law and Regulations.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the systems and purposes of major telecommunications laws and explain them.
Be able to understand the content and terms of each law and explain them.
Be able to understand the corresponding cases in each law and explain them.
Be able to solve the exam questions for chief telecommunications engineer.
